newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit slips on dollar covering, seen rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit slips on dollar covering, seen rangebound.

text.p: The ringgit slipped against the dollar in early Asian trading on covering of short dollar positions, dealers said.
"The market is buying back the dollar after heavy sales on Friday," said a European bank dealer in Kuala Lumpur.
He said the dollar should be heading higher as more covering activities were expected through the day.
"The market is short dollar at the moment," he said.
But dealers said corporate sales out of Kuala Lumpur could again cap the dollar's rise around 2.5180.
A lack of fresh leads and tight movements of the dollar/majors would keep the ringgit rangebound, they said.
Also, Bank Negara did not come out with any policy change after its meeting with bankers on Friday which could determine the direction of the ringgit.
Offshore players had sold dollar/ringgit aggressively on Thursday on fears the central bank would impose capital controls like those of Thailand.
At 0200 GMT, ringgit was quoted at 2.5154/59 a dollar against 2.5131/41 at Kuala Lumpur close on Friday.
